name: Devoted Heart
descriptionTemplate: At the end of each turn, when the corresponding Awakener for the last Command Card is played, gain 20 Aliemus. If also possessing the Relic {Mother Effigy}, grant other Awakeners 5 Aliemus.
lore: "I'll give you anything, anything at all. Please spare me."
